answer: A mechanism that actually bites: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because forge only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, ripple is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any lagoon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
